name: Madison Summer Arts
description_short: Four week half day summer arts program at the Madison Community House for students entering grades 1 to 12. Students take 45 minute classes in band, orchestra, chamber strings, jazz ensemble, music theater, chorus and visual art, grouped by grade.
notes: Classes run between 9 a.m. and 12:15 p.m., Monday to Friday. Early bird pricing through April 30; all registrations due June 5. The brochure credits the Department of Visual and Performing Arts, and the contact is a Madison public schools address. Prices are on brochure pages that did not load.
